lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Shadows trace the wall
Silent in the hall
Breathing in the dark
Waiting for a spark
[chorus]
Lost in the velvet night
Fading away from sight
Caught in the rhythmic glow
Moving with nowhere to go
[verse]
Tracing lines of chrome
Finding ways back home
Distant pulse inside
Nowhere left to hide
[chorus]
Lost in the velvet night
Fading away from sight
Caught in the rhythmic glow
Moving with nowhere to go
[bridge]
Glass breaking slowly
Truth becoming holy
Deeper than the sound
Lost and then we're found
[chorus]
Lost in the velvet night
Fading away from sight
Caught in the rhythmic glow
Moving with nowhere to go
[outro]
